rules.title: Duty Hours & Night Driving
rules.detail: Driver duty is predefined by the itinerary. No regular duty after 8:00 PM; late-night driving beyond itinerary attracts overtime of ₹500/hour. Night driving on hill sectors is discouraged for passenger safety.

rules.title: Commercial Yellow Plates Mandatory
rules.detail: Only verified commercial tourist vehicles with yellow registration plates and active fitness, insurance, and road tax are operated. White private plates are strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Fixed Route & Itinerary Adherence
rules.detail: Vehicles are provided strictly on the agreed route declaration and not on unlimited free disposal.

rules.title: Air Conditioning (AC) Policy
rules.detail: AC operates on flat plains and national highways. As per transporter union standards, AC is switched off on steep hill climbs to preserve engine torque, and on stationary/parked vehicles.

rules.title: Payment Schedule
rules.detail: 30% advance deposit at the time of booking reservation, and the remaining 70% payable upon vehicle arrival and pickup in Guwahati.

rules.title: Sunrise & Off-Road Excursions
rules.detail: Midnight departures for sunrise viewpoints (e.g., Nongjrong, Mandala Top) or extreme terrain (Chakzam Bridge, Mago, Zemithang) require prior mutual agreement and separate union supplements.

rules.title: Spot Guides for Sensitive Locations
rules.detail: Remote areas including Wari Chora, Siju Cave, Double Decker root bridge, and Mawphlang Sacred Forest require hiring registered local spot guides to safeguard heritage and local integrity.

rules.title: Cleanliness & Environment Code
rules.detail: Strict zero-littering policy inside vehicles and across sensitive tribal regions. Government fines up to ₹5,000 apply for littering in tourist belts.
